name: Solid American Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid American oak slats with three coats of low-satin polyurethane, backed by 9mm black acoustic felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: 8 square-cut 1.06 in solid oak slats per panel, 0.41 in black PET felt gaps, 1.47 in pitch, 0.51 in slat thickness over 9 mm felt, and 0.87 in total depth with three coats of low-satin polyurethane. Tile covers 8 pitches by 23.52 in (11.76 in wide, preserving the specified face/gap sizes despite the separately listed 11.81 in installed panel width); oak tones are sampled from the main listing photo, with procedural wrapping grain and black felt.
